All four Dependabot PRs are merged to `main`, and `main`'s CI + prebuild is green after each merge. Done.

## Summary

| PR | Update | Outcome |
|----|--------|---------|
| **#72** | cargo `bytes` 1.11.1 → 1.12.0 | Merged — was only BEHIND; updated branch, merged when green |
| **#73** | `python-semantic-release` 10.5.3 → 10.6.1 | Merged — updated branch, merged when green |
| **#74** | `uv-build` `>=0.11.26,<0.12` | Merged — updated branch, merged when green |
| **#75** | npm-minor-patch group (8 updates) | **Failed → fixed → merged** |

Three of the four were simply out of date with `main` (dependabot stops auto-rebasing once you push to its branch, so I used the update-branch API before each merge). After each merge I verified `main`'s CI and prebuild went green before advancing the next PR.

**#75 needed two fixes**, both recurring dependabot hazards in this repo:
1. **Lockfile corruption** — dependabot rewrote `pnpm-lock.yaml`'s `typescript-eslint` importer from the `catalog:` specifier to a concrete version and dropped its catalogs entry, which fails the frozen-lockfile install. I regenerated the lockfile with the repo-pinned pnpm. (The original CI failure also showed a `minimumReleaseAge` violation on day-old `@eslint-react/*` 5.11.2 packages, but that cutoff had already expired by the time I re-ran.)
2. **commitlint parity gate** — dependabot's own commit body carries an `updated-dependencies:` YAML block that commitlint reads as a malformed footer (`footer-leading-blank`). This gate only runs on ts-touching PRs, which is why the cargo/uv PRs were unaffected. I collapsed dependabot's commit plus my lockfile fix into a single clean Conventional commit and force-pushed.

I also cleaned up the temporary worktree/branch used for the #75 fix, and recorded the dependabot-specific commitlint + lockfile pattern to memory so the next `/ts` npm-group PR is a faster fix. No open Dependabot PRs remain.
